# SLOP CANNON: Idle Ops

> A free idle/incremental browser game and programmer-humor parody. You fire AI-generated "slop" code at production servers, hire AI agents that break prod for you, pivot to AI for hype, rewrite it in Rust, and try to take down us-east-1. Plays instantly at https://slopcannonthegame.com/ with no signup, download or account.

- Genre: idle game, incremental game, clicker game, parody
- Platform: any modern web browser, desktop or mobile
- Price: free, no ads, no in-app purchases
- Made by Bryan te Beek ([@bryantebeek](https://x.com/bryantebeek)); first released 2026-10-14
- Progress saves automatically in the browser and keeps earning while you're away
- All servers, outages, companies and quotes in the game are fictional parody

## Play

- [Play SLOP CANNON](https://slopcannonthegame.com/): the game itself, a single page that runs in the browser

## Docs

- [Full game guide](https://slopcannonthegame.com/llms-full.txt): every agent, cannon mode, zero-day effect, boss, prestige layer and challenge run in one file
- [README](https://github.com/bryantebeek/slop-cannon/blob/main/README.md): overview, controls and how the game is built
